title: FaceTrust AI
description: Face-first identity verification for Nigeria. FaceTrust AI links a NIN or BVN registry identity to a real, live face, with a liveness check every time, then reuses that proof to identify people 1:N at a merchant desk, bank branch, or front desk in under a second. It ships as a consumer app, a Merchant Desk, and an Institution Console.
